headline: Rules of procedure, back shore reconsideration, and a $99.14 contribution to the October 17 Climate Resilience Conference.
summary: The meeting covers adopting rules of procedure and reconsidering a back shore presentation from the Department of Public Works. It also includes a motion to combine two committees and a $99.14 contribution to a climate conference.
items: Public comment on public works issues (3 minutes per speaker)
Joint committee report: Environment and Sustainability and Parks, Recreation, and Waterfront
Ferry Services and Access committee report
Motion to adopt Rules of Procedure (unfinished business)
Motion to reconsider presentation from Department of Public Works regarding back shore
Motion to combine Environment & Sustainability with Parks & Rec, and to nominate Jonah to chair the Parking Committee
Motion to create Nominating Committee for PIC Members and MIC Alternate Member
Motion for the PIC to contribute $99.14 to the cost of the October 17 Climate Resilience Conference
Report out on the Climate Conference (Jess B.)
General public comment (3 minutes per speaker)
location: Peaks Community Center (in person) and meet.google.com/zdh-xdto-tpg (online)
